en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Jameel, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>,

‘I said, ‘The man buys the goods from the man, then he leaves it with him saying, ‘(Keep it) until I come to you with its price’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Either he comes up with its price in what is between it and three days, or else, so there is no sale for him’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Jamil from Zurarah

who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who purchases something from a man and leaves it with him saying, ‘I will come back with payment.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘If he comes back with payment within three days the transaction is valid, otherwise, it is not valid.’”
